top_signals.title: Bolsonaro to Unleash Petrobras Without Privatizing, Adviser Says
top_signals.summary: If Flávio Bolsonaro wins Brazil’s presidential runoff on Oct. 25, he will give the nation’s state oil company broad freedom to reshape its portfolio while seeking to bring more private investment into sectors dominated by the state-controlled oil producer, according to one of his energy advisers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.summary: Banking advocacy organizations are pushing back against the OCC’s finalized rules on a stablecoin law, arguing against changes to provisions on yield.
